title: Current Rectification and Singular Locus Absorption on Kähler Manifolds: Resolving the Singular Intersection Obstruction via Hironaka Desingularization and Federer-Fleming Currents
description: Formal Lean 4 machine-certified proof and numerical verification of the Current Rectification and Singular Locus Absorption Theorem, establishing that codimension >= p+1 singular loci carry zero current boundary mass and exceptional divisors vanish under pushforward. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
